newsitem.title: MOZAMBIQUE: SOCCER-MOZAMBIQUE TROUNCE TANZANIA IN COSAFA CASTLE CUP.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-MOZAMBIQUE TROUNCE TANZANIA IN COSAFA CASTLE CUP.

text.p: Captain Tico-Tico struck twice to lead Mozambique to a 3-0 win (half-time 0-0) over Tanzania in Maputo on Sunday and put them on top of the standings in the Cosafa Castle Cup.

Sustitute Adelino scored the other goal in a one-sided victory over a Tanzania team which finished with 10 men in the new regional competition for members of the Confederation of Southern African Football Associations.
Mozambique lead with four points from two games, ahead of Zambia who won their opening match in April. Five countries are competing in a league competition which continues to the end of August.
Tico-Tico capitalised on a error by his Tanzanian counterpart Hussein Marsha to open the score five minutes into the second half and then hit a thunderous full-volley for the second after 69 minutes.
Adelino, taking advantage of a porous Tanzania defence hit by the dismissal of Yusuf Macho in the 73rd minute, headed home the third goal 15 minutes from time.
The result came as a major boost to the Mozambicans, who host Zambia in Maputo next Sunday in a vital African Nations Cup qualifier.
